title: Decision: compile-time WhoIsProvider conformance check
description: main.rs contains a dead (never-called) function _assert_local_api_client_implements_whois_provider that instantiates a generic bound _check::<LocalApiClient>(). This is correct: it causes the compiler to verify that LocalApiClient satisfies WhoIsProvider + Send + Sync + 'static at compile time, catching trait drift before it reaches runtime. The #[allow(dead_code)] attribute keeps clippy quiet without removing the check. This pattern is preferable to a runtime assertion or integration test for a pure type-level invariant.
